question: How much financial benefit does an eligible farmer family get per year under PM-KISAN, and in how many instalments?
answer: Rs. 6000 per year, released in three instalments of Rs. 2000 each every four months.
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: What is the cut-off date for determining eligibility of beneficiaries under PM-KISAN?
answer: 01.02.2019; no changes after that date are considered for the next 5 years.
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: Are retired pensioners excluded from PM-KISAN?
answer: Superannuated/retired pensioners whose monthly pension is Rs. 10,000 or more are excluded (except Multi Tasking Staff / Class IV / Group D).
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: Within how much time should grievances under PM-KISAN be disposed of?
answer: On merit, preferably within two weeks.
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: From which instalment is the Aadhaar number compulsory for PM-KISAN payments?
answer: Aadhaar is compulsory for release of the second instalment onwards (amendment to para 8.1, 11.03.2019).
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: What percentage of PM-KISAN beneficiaries should States physically verify for eligibility each year?
answer: Around 5% of beneficiaries.
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: What is the maximum first tranche loan under PM SVANidhi and over how many months is it repaid?
answer: Up to Rs 15,000, repaid in 12 months.
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: At what rate is interest subsidy given to street vendors who take loans under PM SVANidhi?
answer: 7% per annum, credited quarterly.
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: Until what date has the lending period of PM SVANidhi been extended?
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: Which PM SVANidhi beneficiaries can get the UPI-linked RuPay credit card?
answer: Those who have successfully repaid the 2nd tranche loan and are eligible for the 3rd tranche loan.
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: What is the maximum yearly cashback a street vendor can earn on retail digital transactions under PM SVANidhi?
answer: Up to Rs 100 per month (Rs 1 per transaction), maximum Rs 1,200 per year in each tranche.
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: What credit guarantee cover does CGTMSE provide on the first tranche PM SVANidhi loan?
answer: 31.87% for the 1st tranche (8.25% for the 2nd, 6% for the 3rd), on portfolio basis.
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: What size of bank loans does the Stand-Up India scheme facilitate, and for whom?
answer: Loans between Rs 10 lakh and Rs 1 crore to at least one SC/ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch, for a greenfield enterprise.
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: When and where was the Stand-Up India scheme launched?
answer: On April 05, 2016 in Noida, Uttar Pradesh.
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: How much margin money must a borrower bring under Stand-Up India after the 2021-22 changes?
answer: Reduced from up to 25% to up to 15% of the project cost.
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: What is the maximum repayment period and moratorium for a Stand-Up India loan?
answer: Repayment up to 7 years with a moratorium of up to 18 months.
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: For how many years will PMAY-Urban 2.0 be implemented and from which date?
answer: For 5 years from 01.09.2024.
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: What is the minimum carpet area of a house supported under PMAY-U 2.0?
answer: 30 sqm minimum (houses up to 45 sqm allowed).
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: What are the annual household income limits for EWS, LIG and MIG under PMAY-U 2.0?
answer: EWS up to Rs 3 lakh; LIG Rs 3-6 lakh; MIG Rs 6-9 lakh.
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: What is the maximum interest subsidy a beneficiary can receive under the Interest Subsidy Scheme of PMAY-U 2.0?
answer: Rs 1.80 lakh actual release (NPV Rs 1.50 lakh), released in 5 annual instalments.
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: What maximum loan amount and house value are eligible for interest subsidy under PMAY-U 2.0?
answer: Loans up to Rs 25 lakh for houses valued up to Rs 35 lakh; 4% subsidy on the first Rs 8 lakh.
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: In whose name should a house built with PMAY-U 2.0 central assistance be registered?
answer: In the name of the female head of the household or jointly with her husband; individual's name for widowers, unmarried, separated or transgender applicants.
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: What minimum share of houses must be for the EWS category for an AHP project to get central assistance?
answer: At least 25% of houses for EWS, and a single project must have at least 100 houses.
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: In what ratio are Technology Innovation Grant instalments for ARH projects released by MoHUA?
answer: Three instalments in the ratio 40:40:20.
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: How much central assistance per unit is given under BLC/AHP to North Eastern and Himalayan States under PMAY-U 2.0?
answer: Rs 2.25 lakh per unit from the Centre, with a minimum State share of Rs 0.25 lakh per unit.
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: Which groups get preference under PMAY-U 2.0?
answer: Widows, single women, persons with disabilities, senior citizens, transgenders, SC/ST, minorities and other weaker and vulnerable sections.
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: Which families are targeted as beneficiaries of AB PM-JAY according to the beneficiary identification guidelines?
answer: Deprived rural families and identified urban occupational worker families as per SECC data, plus RSBY-enrolled families not in the SECC target groups.
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: Is presenting the AB PM-JAY e-card mandatory for availing services?
answer: No, presentation of the e-card is not mandatory for availing services.
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: Which identity documents are collected when verifying a beneficiary under AB PM-JAY?
answer: Aadhaar (or an alternative government ID) and a ration card (or an alternative family ID).
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: Can new family members be added to an AB PM-JAY family, and what is required?
answer: Yes, if at least one other family member is already approved; proof such as the family ration card or State family card is required.
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: How many days of guaranteed wage employment per financial year does the Haryana Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme provide to each rural household?
answer: Not less than one hundred days.
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: Within what distance from the applicant's village should employment be provided under the Haryana Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme?
answer: As far as possible within a radius of five kilometres.
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: Within how many days of receiving an application must work be provided under the Haryana Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme?
answer: Within fifteen days of receipt of the application.
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: Up to what value of works can a Gram Panchayat give administrative approval under the Haryana Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme?
answer: Up to Rs. 3.00 lakh (Panchayat Samiti Rs. 5 lakh, Zila Parishad Rs. 10 lakh).
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: What facilities must be arranged at worksites under the Haryana Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme?
answer: Drinking water, shade for children and workers, and a first aid box for emergency treatment, among others.
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: After the 2012 MGNREGA Schedule amendment, which households can have works under items (iv), (x), (xi) and (xiii) to (xv) of paragraph 1B on their land?
answer: SC/ST households, BPL families, land-reform beneficiaries, Indira Awas Yojana beneficiaries, small or marginal farmers, and Forest Rights Act beneficiaries.
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: At what rate is unemployment allowance paid under the Haryana unemployment allowance rules?
answer: One-fourth of the prevailing wage rate for the first thirty days and half of the wage rate for the remaining period.
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: Where can a person aggrieved by the Programme Officer's order on unemployment allowance appeal, and how fast must it be decided?
answer: To the District Programme Coordinator within fifteen days; the appeal is disposed of within thirty days.
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना-शहरी 2.0 में ईडब्ल्यूएस, एलआईजी और एमआईजी परिवारों की वार्षिक आय सीमा क्या है?
answer: ईडब्ल्यूएस ₹3 लाख तक, एलआईजी ₹6 लाख तक, एमआईजी ₹9 लाख तक।
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: भागीदारी में किफायती आवास (एएचपी) परियोजना को केन्द्रीय सहायता के लिए कम से कम कितने प्रतिशत आवास ईडब्ल्यूएस श्रेणी के लिए होने चाहिए?
answer: कम से कम 25% आवास ईडब्ल्यूएस श्रेणी के लिए और परियोजना में कम से कम 100 आवास।
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: लाभार्थी आधारित निर्माण (बीएलसी) के तहत नए पक्के आवास का कारपेट एरिया कितना होना चाहिए?
answer: न्यूनतम 30 वर्ग मीटर और अधिकतम 45 वर्ग मीटर।
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: ब्याज सब्सिडी योजना (आईएसएस) में अधिकतम ऋण मूल्य और मकान की अधिकतम कीमत कितनी है?
answer: अधिकतम ऋण ₹25 लाख और मकान की अधिकतम कीमत ₹35 लाख।
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: मार्च 2023 तक प्रधानमंत्री उज्ज्वला योजना के तहत कुल कितने एलपीजी कनेक्शन दिए गए?
answer: 9.59 करोड़ कनेक्शन।
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: उज्ज्वला योजना के लाभार्थियों के लिए एलपीजी सिलेंडर पर कितनी सब्सिडी को मंजूरी दी गई?
answer: 14.2 किलो के सिलेंडर पर प्रति वर्ष 12 रिफिल तक 200 रुपये की सब्सिडी।
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: प्रधानमंत्री उज्ज्वला योजना का प्रारंभिक लक्ष्य क्या था?
answer: बीपीएल परिवारों की 5 करोड़ महिला सदस्यों को एलपीजी कनेक्शन देना; बाद में लक्ष्य 8 करोड़ किया गया।
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: हरियाणा ग्रामीण रोजगार गारन्टी स्कीम में ग्राम पंचायत कितनी राशि तक के कार्यों के लिए प्रशासनिक स्वीकृति दे सकती है?
answer: तीन लाख रुपये तक।
author: claude-draft (owner to review)

question: बेरोजगारी भत्ता किस दर पर दिया जाएगा?
answer: प्रथम तीस दिन के लिए मजदूरी दर का एक-चौथाई और शेष अवधि के लिए आधा।
author: claude-draft (owner to review)
